canada.title: Coyote attacks, drags child at Toronto’s Edwards Gardens: police
canada.summary: Toronto police are issuing a public safety alert after they say a five-year-old child was attacked by a coyote at a park in North York.

canada.title: All Ontario teachers' unions vote in favour of strike action
canada.summary: Five unions representing more than 250,000 teachers and education workers held strike votes this week, before central bargaining is set to begin before the end of the month.

canada.title: Most advanced model to replace Sask.'s only PET/CT scanner
canada.summary: Royal University Hospital in Saskatoon will be the first prairie facility to get the most advanced PET/CT scanner model. One of only 3 in Canada, it has faster scan times and lower radiation.

canada.title: $200K from N.L. going to downtown St. John’s for private security foot patrols
canada.summary: On Thursday Newfoundland and Labrador’s justice minister announced $200,000 in funding to boost safety in downtown St. John’s, which is going towards uniformed foot patrols. Downtown St. John’s chair Jonathan Loder says it will act as a deterrent against crime.

canada.title: Calgary mayor says he believes revisions coming to Alberta bike lane bill
canada.summary: Jeromy Farkas said Premier Danielle Smith's office promised municipalities would not foot the bill for bike lanes the province orders removed.

canada.title: Bay du Nord offshore oil project off N.L. clears last major regulatory hurdle
canada.summary: Whether or not the Bay du Nord offshore oil project moves ahead is now up to the companies behind it, as the project has secured its last milestone approval from government.

canada.title: City of Montreal backtracks and appoints executive responsible for systemic racism
canada.summary: Montreal Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada has named a councillor responsible for racism and discrimination at its executive committee following a cabinet shuffle.

canada.title: « Nous prenons soin les uns des autres. » : témoignages du square Cabot
canada.summary: Les habitués et les intervenants décrivent les relations entre les gens sans-abri et la police à Cabot Square comme marquées par la méfiance et la peur.

canada.title: N.S. school support workers’ union seeks renewed talks after members reject offer
canada.summary: The union representing school support workers in Nova Scotia is calling on the provincial government to resume contract negotiations by noon on Monday.

canada.title: ‘We’re at a loss’: Private clinics frustrated by provincial cap on cataract surgeries
canada.summary: In 2025, New Brunswick started funding cataract surgeries in private clinics to address a significant patient backlog. But with more than four months left in the fiscal year, some clinics are already close to hitting their quotas.

canada.title: Province in talks with Quebec-based company about idled Nackawic pulp mill
canada.summary: The AV Group stopped production at its Nackawic pulp mill in early November, but Natural Resources Minister John Herron told the legislature Friday that he’s hopeful the province can find another operator.

canada.title: Premier Lorne Doerkson sworn in alongside 1st B.C. Conservative cabinet
canada.summary: Lorne Doerkson announced his cabinet Friday after being sworn in as B.C.'s 38th premier by Lt.-Gov. Wendy Cocchia. It is the first time the B.C. Conservative Party has been elected to government in more than 100 years.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Vancouver Sun, Global News

canada.title: Borough mayor leaves Ensemble Montréal over city's upcoming budget
canada.summary: Just days before unveiling Montreal's 2027 municipal budget, Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada has reshuffled the city's executive committee.

canada.title: Nova Scotia marks Transgender Day of Remembrance with flag-raising and poetry
canada.summary: The annual occasion honours transgender and gender-diverse people whose lives were lost to anti-transgender violence and hatred.

canada.title: Alberta tweaks carbon capture incentive program to allow grants during construction
canada.summary: The change to cover 12 per cent of eligible capital costs is meant to better align provincial policy with the federal Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage Tax Credit.

canada.title: Woman charged with 2nd-degree murder after senior killed in Winnipeg
canada.summary: A 43-year-old woman has been charged with second-degree murder after a 70-year-old man was found dead in a home in Winnipeg's North End.

canada.title: Indian national gets more than 19 years in prison over plot to kill Sikh leader
canada.summary: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty earlier this year to charges related to a murder-for-hire scheme for attempting to kill Gurpatwant Singh Pannun.

canada.title: Ontario fugitive arrested in Winnipeg hours after making most wanted list
canada.summary: An Ontario fugitive wanted in connection with two Toronto-area shootings was arrested in Winnipeg Thursday, less than six hours after being placed on Canada’s most wanted list.
